title: Personalized Language Models for One-to-Many Private Communications
abstract: arXiv:2611.19155v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study relationship-specific continual reply prediction for one-to-many private communication: a system predicts an author's reply to a recurring contact and updates its personalization state when the actual reply becomes available. We propose TRACE (Temporal Relationship-Aware Communication Evolution), which uses author-level lexical habits, contact-specific wording, and temporal expression estimates to guide a frozen language model, with a feedback-driven policy controlling revision. On 216 test emails from eight Enron users, all four main TRACE configurations achieve higher mean BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore and lower mean Reply Style MSE than Base LLM and Base RAG. Component ablations show mixed effects and do not establish statistically reliable improvements in Reply Style MSE after multiple-comparison correction. translated_title: 面向一对多私人通信的个性化语言模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究面向一对多私人通信的关系特定的持续回复预测任务：系统预测作者对某个经常性联系人的回复，并在实际回复可用时更新其个性化状态。我们提出TRACE（时间关系感知通信演化），该方法利用作者级别的词汇习惯、联系人特定的措辞以及时间表达估计来引导一个冻结的语言模型，并通过反馈驱动的策略来控制修订。在来自八位Enron用户的216封测试邮件上，全部四个主要的TRACE配置均比基础LLM和基础RAG取得了更高的平均BLEU、ROUGE-L和BERTScore，以及更低的平均回复风格MSE。组件消融实验显示出混合效应，且经过多重比较校正后，未能确立回复风格MSE在统计上可靠的改进。更准确的状态预测和更大的修订预算并不能一致地改善回复级别的指标。这些探索性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TRACE框架，利用作者词汇习惯、联系人特定措辞和时间表达估计来引导冻结语言模型并配合反馈驱动的修订策略，实现一对多私人通信中针对特定关系的持续回复预测与个性化状态更新，在Enron邮件数据上优于基础LLM和RAG基线。
en_tdlr: TRACE is proposed for relationship-specific continual reply prediction in one-to-many private communications, guiding a frozen language model with author-level lexical habits, contact-specific wording, and temporal expression estimates under a feedback-driven revision policy, outperforming Base LLM and Base RAG on Enron email data.
